summary.en: Who waits for whom: four session windows log their work; lamps light where an agent waits, a rope drags the vermilion stamp over to press each lamp and type the reply; calls come faster until all four pull at once.
summary.zh: 谁在等谁：四个会话窗口各自跑日志；agent 等人时亮灯，一根绳子把朱印拽过去按灯、打出回复；越叫越快，最后四根一起拽。

fits: Showing that a person, not the machine, is the bottleneck; parallel agents waiting on one human.
notFor: One agent; work that does not wait on a person.

intent.en: Reverse the viewer's belief: the person thought they were directing the agents; the picture shows the agents pulling the person.
intent.zh: 翻转观众的看法：以为是人在指挥 agent；画面里是 agent 在拽人。

content.en: Four window titles (≤ 12 / 6), log lines per window (≤ 26 / 12), a waiting line, the replies (≤ 14 / 5), call times, an optional struck-out guess, a label and a figure.
content.zh: 四个窗口名（≤ 12 / 6）、每窗日志（≤ 26 / 12）、一句等待语、回复（≤ 14 / 5）、叫人的时刻、可选被划掉的猜测、一条说明和一个数字。

fits.zh: 表现瓶颈是人而不是机器；多个 agent 并行地等一个人。

notFor.zh: 只有一个 agent；不需要等人的工作。

en: The stamp parks beside the lamp row, never on the log text.
Speed the calls up (0.75 → 0.45 s) only after the slow ones were readable.
zh: 印章停在灯排旁边，不压日志字。
慢的几次能看清之后才加速（0.75 → 0.45 秒）。
